games_scores_nonneg_ck.name: games_scores_nonneg_ck
games_scores_nonneg_ck.value: ("games"."home_score" is null or "games"."home_score" >= 0) and ("games"."away_score" is null or "games"."away_score" >= 0)

games_final_complete_ck.name: games_final_complete_ck
games_final_complete_ck.value: "games"."status" <> 'final' or ("games"."result_type" = 'forfeit' and "games"."forfeit_winner" is not null) or ("games"."result_type" = 'played' and "games"."home_score" is not null and "games"."away_score" is not null)

games_distinct_teams_ck.name: games_distinct_teams_ck
